problem_statement: Casual walkers lack a simple, centralized way to monitor their daily physical activity and hydration levels to support general health goals.
objectives: Enable users to log and track daily step counts.
Enable users to log and track daily water intake.
Provide a clear, accessible browser-based dashboard for health data visualization.

user_stories.story: As a casual walker, I want to log my daily step count, so that I can monitor my physical activity levels.
As a casual walker, I want to log my daily water intake, so that I can ensure I am staying hydrated.
As a casual walker, I want to view a dashboard of my daily activity and hydration, so that I can track my progress over time.

functional_requirements.description: The system shall allow the user to input a numerical value for daily steps.
The system shall allow the user to input a numerical value for daily water intake in milliliters.
The system shall display a dashboard summarizing the current day's steps and water intake.
The system shall validate that all user-provided numerical inputs are positive integers.

non_functional_requirements.description: The system shall sanitize all user inputs to prevent injection attacks, ensuring no malicious scripts are executed via the dashboard.
The dashboard shall be responsive and accessible via standard modern web browsers.
The system shall ensure data integrity by rejecting non-numeric or negative values during input.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given the user is on the input page, When they enter a positive integer for steps, Then the system saves the value successfully.
Given the user attempts to enter a negative number or text, When they submit the form, Then the system displays an error message and rejects the input.
Given the user has logged data, When they navigate to the dashboard, Then the system displays the correct totals for the current date.

constraints.description: The interface must be a browser-based dashboard.

assumptions.description: Users will manually input their data rather than syncing with wearable hardware for V1.
The system will track data on a daily basis, resetting at midnight local time.

out_of_scope: Historical data analysis beyond current day

open_questions.question: Should the system support multiple users, or is it intended for a single-user local instance?
What is the maximum expected value for daily steps and water intake to define appropriate input field limits?
